name: Robot Software, ROS & Simulation
summary: How robot software is structured and built with ROS 2, from nodes, topics and transforms to navigation, manipulation and physics simulation.

topics.name: Robot software architectures: sense-plan-act, behaviour-based, hybrid
ROS 2 concepts: nodes, topics, services, actions, parameters
DDS middleware and quality of service
Workspaces, packages, colcon builds and launch files
Coordinate frames and transforms with tf2
Robot description: URDF, Xacro and SDF
Visualization and debugging: RViz, rqt, rosbag2
Physics simulation: Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Webots, PyBullet
Motion planning and manipulation with MoveIt 2
Perception pipelines: OpenCV and point-cloud bridges
Task execution with behaviour trees and state machines
Testing, CI and containerized deployment of robot software
